data.explanation: Finanzamt Musterstadt (the tax office) has assessed your income tax for 2025 at €1,234.00, with no solidarity surcharge due. Because more tax was already withheld from your salary than owed, you are entitled to a refund of €312.45, which will be paid into your bank account automatically — no action is needed for the refund itself. If you disagree with the assessment (e.g. with how expenses were calculated), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt in writing or electronically (e.g. via ELSTER); the app shows the deadline. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final and cannot be challenged later.
